assumptions: The recorded worktree of claim #2745 is used by another session with uncommitted work, so the rebind never inspects or touches the old worktree.
Renewal of an active lease is refused by design, so rebind requires an active lease and asks for renewal first otherwise.
goal: Add a guarded --rebind-claim-worktree mode to the lane manager that moves a live claim to a new clean worktree on the claim branch at the exact open PR head, with owner proof, mutex, exact readback, rollback and create-only evidence, covered by tests.
prohibited_actions: Do not inspect, modify or clean the claim's previously recorded worktree.
Do not weaken any existing lane guard, renewal refusal or supersession check.
Do not change any database structure or data.
stop_conditions: Stop if moving the claim could only be done by bypassing owner proof or the mutex.
